newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Vuna, Group Five in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Vuna, Group Five in joint venture.

text.p: South Africa's Vuna Industrial Holdings, the industrial arm of black-owned Thebe Investment Corp, has formed a joint venture with Group Five Engineering, part of Group Five Ltd.
Thebe said in a statement on Thursday the new company, to be known as Vuna Group Five Technologies, is expected to have turnover of 50 million rand in the current financial year.
Vuna will own 51 percent of the new company, and Group Five the remaining 49 percent.
Vuna Group Five Technologies would undertake electrical and instrumentation construction projects as well as related maintenance.
It is currently involved with contracts at Sasol I and III, Majuba power station and in other African countries, Thebe said.
